description: This bar chart, titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks," visually compares the performance of two models—Llama-3-8B-it (represented by blue bars) and Ours (Iterative RLHF, represented by orange bars)—across nine distinct academic and practical benchmarks. The horizontal axis, labeled "Dataset and Metrics," lists the benchmarks in left-to-right order: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis, labeled "Score (%)," is scaled linearly from 0 to 80, with tick marks at intervals of 10, indicating the percentage score achieved by each model on each benchmark. Each benchmark has two adjacent bars: the blue bar for Llama-3-8B-it and the orange bar for Ours. The chart shows that on GSM-8K, both models score very high, with Llama-3-8B-it at approximately 79% and Ours at approximately 80%. On MMLU, Llama-3-8B-it scores about 66% while Ours scores about 65%. On HumanEval, Llama-3-8B-it scores about 61% and Ours scores about 64%. On TruthfulQA, Llama-3-8B-it scores about 43% and Ours scores about 60%. On ARC, Llama-3-8B-it scores about 59% and Ours scores about 63%. On MBPP, Llama-3-8B-it scores about 61% and Ours scores about 61%. On LC AlpacaEval2, Llama-3-8B-it scores about 23% and Ours scores about 31%. On MT-Bench (×5), Llama-3-8B-it scores about 41% and Ours scores about 42%. On Chat-Arena-Hard, Llama-3-8B-it scores about 21% and Ours scores about 30%. The bars are not sorted by value; they are presented in the order of the datasets listed on the x-axis. The chart includes a legend in the top right corner identifying the blue bar as "Llama-3-8B-it" and the orange bar as "Ours (Iterative RLHF)."
